metadata.title: Cooky: what do I cook today?
metadata.description: Your recipe box, your kitchen and the weather, together. Cooky helps you decide what to cook, plan the week, shop once and cook with friends.

home.headline: What do I cook today?
home.tagline: Plan, cook, and shop without the guesswork.

decide.title: Decide in seconds
decide.body: Cooky ranks your own dishes by what's already in your kitchen, the season and today's weather.

plan.title: Plan, shop, cook
plan.body: Plan the week, host guests, get one merged shopping list and cook step by step with timers.

share.title: Cook with friends
share.body: Share recipes with the people you choose, chat, and see what they loved.

notFound.title: This page isn't on the menu
notFound.description: The link may be old or mistyped. Go back home to keep cooking.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong on our side
errorPage.description: Nothing you did caused this, and your data is safe. Try again, or go back home.

errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
errors.invalid: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.rate_limited: That was a lot at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.quota_exceeded: You've used all your tries for this period.
errors.conflict: This changed somewhere else. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.unavailable: This isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.

emails.footer: You're receiving this because this address was used on Cooky.
emails.linkFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Cooky
verifyEmail.preview: Confirm your email to start cooking with Cooky.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Tap the button to confirm this is your email address. Then you can log in.
verifyEmail.ignore: Didn't sign up for Cooky? You can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Cooky password
resetPassword.preview: Choose a new password for Cooky.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We got a request to reset your password. Tap the button to choose a new one.
resetPassword.expiry: This link works for 1 hour and only once.
resetPassword.ignore: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email and your password stays the same.

passwordChanged.subject: Your Cooky password was changed
passwordChanged.preview: Your Cooky password was just changed.
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your Cooky account was just changed, and every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.expiry: If this was you, there's nothing else to do.
passwordChanged.ignore: If it wasn't you, reset your password right away to lock your account back down.

trialEnding.subject: Your Cooky trial ends in 3 days
trialEnding.preview: Your free trial ends soon. Here's what happens next.
trialEnding.heading: Your trial ends in 3 days
trialEnding.body: When your trial ends, your plan continues and your card is charged. Want to change plans or cancel? You can do it any time before then.
trialEnding.expiry: Cancel before the trial ends and you won't be charged.
trialEnding.ignore: Happy with your plan? There's nothing to do.

paymentFailed.subject: Your Cooky payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.preview: Update your card to keep your plan.
paymentFailed.heading: Your payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.body: We couldn't charge your card for your Cooky plan. Your plan stays on for 7 days while we try again.
paymentFailed.expiry: After 7 days without a payment, your account moves to Free. Your dishes and lists stay safe.
paymentFailed.ignore: Already updated your card? We'll retry automatically.

cancellationConfirmed.subject: Your Cooky plan is cancelled
cancellationConfirmed.preview: Your plan stays on until the end of this billing period.
cancellationConfirmed.heading: Your plan is cancelled
cancellationConfirmed.body: You keep everything in your plan until the end of this billing period. After that, your account moves to Free and you won't be charged again.
cancellationConfirmed.expiry: Changed your mind? You can restart your plan any time before it ends.
cancellationConfirmed.ignore: Your dishes, lists and collections stay safe on Free.

receipt.subject: Your Cooky receipt
receipt.preview: Thanks for your payment. Your receipt is ready.
receipt.heading: Thanks for your payment
receipt.body: Your payment for Cooky went through. Your receipt has the amount, date and tax details.
receipt.expiry: You can find all your receipts in Settings, under Plan & billing.
receipt.ignore: Didn't expect this payment? Check Plan & billing in Settings to see which plan you're on.

auth.nameHint: Friends see this when you share recipes.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Don't reuse a password from another site.
auth.compromised: This password appeared in a data breach, so it isn't safe. Choose a different one.
auth.consent: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signUp.title: Create your Cooky account
signUp.subtitle: Your recipes, your kitchen, your week. Free to start.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address and you'll be signed in.
signUp.checkEmailHint: Nothing after a few minutes? Look in spam, or send the link again.
signUp.resent: A new link is on its way.

logIn.title: Log in to Cooky
logIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Your kitchen is waiting.
logIn.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check both and try again.
logIn.verifyEmail: Confirm your email first. We just sent a new link to {email}.
logIn.locked: Too many wrong passwords. For your safety, try again after {time}, or reset your password.
logIn.lockedGeneric: Too many wrong passwords. For your safety, wait a few minutes and try again, or reset your password.
logIn.passkeyHint: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
logIn.passkeyNotRecognised: That passkey isn't linked to a Cooky account. Log in with your email instead.
logIn.passkeyCancelled: Passkey sign-in was cancelled. Try again, or log in with your email.
logIn.suspended: This account has been suspended. If you think this is a mistake, reply to any email you've received from Cooky.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses {email}, a reset link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you don't use anywhere else.
reset.doneBody: Log in with your new password. For your safety, every device was signed out.
reset.invalidBody: Reset links work for 1 hour and only once. Ask for a new one.

verified.title: Email confirmed
verified.body: Your account is ready and you're signed in.
verified.errorBody: Confirmation links work for 24 hours. Enter your email to get a new one.
verified.sentBody: If {email} still needs confirming, a new link is on its way. It works for 24 hours.

twoFactor.title: Enter your verification code
twoFactor.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Cooky.
twoFactor.trustDeviceHint: Don't tick this on a shared computer.
twoFactor.backupSubtitle: Each backup code works only once.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check the latest code in your app and try again.
twoFactor.invalidBackup: That backup code didn't work. Each code works only once.
twoFactor.expired: This sign-in took too long. Log in again to start over.
twoFactor.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

social.consent: By continuing with Google or Apple, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
social.failed: Signing in with Google or Apple didn't work. Try again, or use your email.
social.notLinked: This email already has a Cooky account that isn't confirmed yet. Confirm it from the email we sent you, then try again.
social.suspended: This account has been suspended. If you think this is a mistake, reply to any email you've received from Cooky.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Control how you log in and where you're logged in.

password.heading: Password
password.description: Changing it signs out every other device.
password.changed: Password changed. Every other device was signed out.
password.noPassword: You log in with Google or Apple, so there's no password to change.

twoFactor.heading: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: When you log in with your password, also ask for a code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.scanBody: Open an authenticator app (like Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password) and scan the code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code to add Cooky to your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualLabel: Can't scan it? Type this key instead:
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Make sure your phone's clock is right and try the latest code.
twoFactor.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
twoFactor.backupBody: If you lose your phone, each code lets you log in once. Keep them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
twoFactor.disableBody: Your account will be protected by your password only. Confirm your password to turn it off.
twoFactor.codesBody: Your old backup codes will stop working. Confirm your password to continue.

passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Log in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add one to log in faster on this device.
passkeys.removeBody: You won't be able to log in with “{name}” anymore. You can add it again later.
passkeys.added: Passkey added. You can now log in with it.
passkeys.failed: Your device couldn't create a passkey. Try again.

devices.heading: Logged-in devices
devices.description: Logged in somewhere you don't recognise? Sign that device out.
devices.name: {browser} on {os}
devices.signOutAllBody: Anyone using your account on another device will need to log in again.
devices.signedOutAll: All other devices were signed out.
devices.onlyThisDevice: You're only logged in on this device.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to friends you share recipes with.
profile.nameHint: Shown on your avatar and to friends.
profile.emailHint: You log in with this address.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.description: Make Cooky comfortable to read. Changes apply right away and follow you to your other devices.
appearance.preview: Plan, cook and shop without the guesswork.
appearance.saveFailed: That change couldn't be saved, so it was undone. Try again.

legal.draftNotice: Draft summary. The full legal text is published before Cooky launches; this version is the one recorded when you sign up.

points.account: You're responsible for your account and for keeping your password private.
points.content: Recipes and notes you add stay yours. You let Cooky store and show them to the people you choose.
points.fairUse: Don't misuse Cooky: no spam, abuse, or attempts to break or overload the service.
points.plans: Paid plans renew until you cancel. Cancelling keeps your plan until the period ends.
points.changes: If these terms change materially, we'll tell you before the new version applies.

points.collect: We keep only what Cooky needs: your account, your recipes and plans, and settings you choose.
points.never: We never sell your data and never show other people your email address.
points.processors: Trusted providers run parts of Cooky for us, such as hosting, email and payments. They act only on our instructions.
points.rights: You can export everything or delete your account at any time from Settings.
points.cookies: We use only the cookies Cooky needs to keep you signed in. No advertising trackers.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
validation.acceptTermsRequired: Agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.
validation.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from your app.
validation.backupCodeFormat: Enter a backup code exactly as you saved it.
